notes_for_editor: Thin record: the NHLR detail page is the main source, and the Forest Lookouts page for Bridge Creek is a header only (Lawrence County, Alabama Forestry Commission) with no body text. Status rests on the NHLR listing and a 2021 photo credit; no current condition, access, staffing or fire history was found in two searches. The Kaufmann column is by the NHLR nominator and is used only for model context and general climbing caution, not for this tower's condition. Height 30.5 m converts the NHLR's 100 ft. Facts omit access and visit because no source supports either. No photos added: the NHLR photo has no image URL in the fetched page. No corrections to the brief's record.
